children: The San Francisco Giants option in the Polymarket market for "San Francisco Giants vs. New York Mets" rose sharply to 91.5% from 49.5% one hour earlier, according to Catcher Predict monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 42% swing in the submarket and may have been influenced by breaking news.

title: San Francisco Giants Option Jumps to 91.5% on Polymarket
